meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。

howto.what: 触发后，Claude 先显示'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!'，随后按证据驱动流程编码：先写失败测试，再实现，用真实运行结果证明交付，并按任务复杂度分级验证。
howto.when: 当你的提示里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发，并持续到整个任务结束。

say.text: ultrawork 帮我把登录接口的 500 错误修好。
say.note: 触发后会用失败测试先行并给出运行证明。

say.text: ulw 给这个项目加一个数据库迁移脚本。
ultrawork 重构订单模块，保持现有功能不变。
say.note: 重活会走更严格的验证流程。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude first displays 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then follows an evidence-driven coding workflow: write a failing test first, implement, prove delivery with real runtime results, and scale verification by task complexity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'; the mode persists for the rest of the task.

say_en.text: ultrawork fix the 500 error on the login endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will start with a failing test and prove the fix.

say_en.text: ulw add a database migration script for this project.
say_en.note: ulw is the shorthand; same effect.

say_en.text: ultrawork refactor the order module without changing behavior.
